Parity vectors for `src/keys/`. Throwaway keys.

- `identity-parity.json`: made from satorilib (the Docker neuron's code) by
  `scripts/identity_fixtures.py` on branch `draft/v1-full`, trimmed to what the
  MVP uses (words, pubkey, address, Evrmore message signatures).
- `identity-js.json`: signatures made by this JS code, which satorilib verified
  (`scripts/identity_crossverify.py` on `draft/v1-full`).
